author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 09/18/2018: CTSH, ORCL, AMZN, INXN
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.3%
AAPL: +0.4%
IBM: +0.1%
CSCO: +0.2%
GOOGL: +0.2%
Technology shares were mostly in positive territory on Tuesday.
Expected movers:
- Cognizant Technology ( CTSH ) said it plans to acquire Advanced Technology Group
- Oracle ( ORCL ) posted better-than-expected Q1earnings and revene below Street forecasts
- Amazon ( AMZN ) is planning to unveil eight new voice-controlled hardware devices before the end of the year
Other news:
- InterXion Holding N.V ( INXN ) unveiled offering of EUR200 million ($233.6 million) aggregate principal amount of its 4.75% senior notes due 2025
News from overseas:
- Ocado Group (OCDO.L) reported that sales jumped in line with its expectations in its fiscal third quarter
